scope: Additive, explicitly negotiated project/migrate intent within protocol-3 atomic_structure_commit. Existing released protocol.json and pins remain immutable.
discovery: get_project_sync_transition_plan returns this profile SHA256 and an exact initialization payload; missing RPC or mismatched SHA256 must block begin.
request: Exactly one project/migrate intent, entity_id equals project_id, base_revision 0, MIGRATING epoch 1, with the complete discovery initialization payload as its immutable payload.
payload: profile_sha256, baseline_sha256, documents, orders. baseline hashes sorted folders, documents excluding body but including body SHA256, and existing ID tree orders. Documents contain id, name, parent_folder_id; orders contain id, parent_folder_id and children. Order IDs use UUID-v5 with the project namespace and migration-tree-order: followed by the lowercase parent UUID.
authorization: Owner only; project advisory transaction lock; authorization rechecked after lock; active migration starter user/device/epoch required. Ordinary atomic calls cannot initialize in LEGACY or ID_BASED.
preparation: prepare_project_sync_transition checks the frozen payload under the lock, begins only in LEGACY, then invokes atomic_structure_commit. Failure raises and rolls back begin, metadata and ledger together. Success remains MIGRATING. Exact batch replay returns the original result, including after completion.
mapping: Use exact recorded paths and authoritative folder IDs, never guessed IDs or renamed paths. Every folder must be reachable from a null-parent root. A document with all four structure fields null is initialized; partial metadata is rejected. Deleted ordinary documents retain identity/content/revision and receive structure metadata too. Ambiguous/missing parents fail closed.
ordering: Existing ID orders are preserved. With no ID orders, valid legacy tree_order keys map to exact folder paths; <root> maps to 메인. Names resolve exactly once to live siblings, preserving list order. Unresolvable entries or mixed legacy/ID order disagreement are rejected, never silently dropped. Absent order entries retain natural order.
preservation: No changes to document IDs, relative paths, content, content revisions, current_version_id, deletion state or document_versions. Reserved UUID-v5 control documents remain unchanged. No history backfill. Structure revision initializes to 1. All metadata is validated before preparation commits.
completion: Validation is read-only. Only a separate explicit complete_project_sync_migration promotes to ID_BASED. No automatic completion, downgrade, sending opt-in or data conversion on deployment.
limits: At most 1000 folders and 1000 documents per preparation. Larger projects fail before begin. No service-role key or direct table writes in clients.
recovery: Client persists the exact request before first send, bound to account/project/device. It retries that request after response loss. Stale local authorization prevents sending and discards UI results, not the journal. Completion response loss is reconciled from freshly observed mode; never followed by another begin.
